title: Refund rounding symmetry
spec: Implement percent_of(amount_cents, percent). amount_cents is an integer that is negative for refunds and positive for charges; percent is an integer from 0 to 100. Return amount_cents * percent / 100 rounded to the nearest integer, with exact halves rounded away from zero, so that a refund mirrors its charge: percent_of(-x, p) == -percent_of(x, p) for every valid x and p. Use integer arithmetic only.
target_defect: Negative amounts are rounded with floor arithmetic, so refund halves round toward zero and refunds do not mirror charges.
author_rationale: Replace floating-point rounding with exact integer arithmetic.
limitations: Synthetic module written by the repository's AI engineering agent after the November 2026 development pilot saturated corpus v1, before any model reviewed it. Designed around omissions, cross-function effects and edge cases stated in the contract. Not a natural pull request; correct means conforming to the stated contract and supplied checks.
